svg.text: Route 53 alias → ALB for the app · CloudFront → private S3 for static assets · two Availability Zones

text.tspan: Security groups: ALB → EC2 TCP/8080 · EC2 → RDS TCP/3306 | Tier NACLs + ephemeral return ports | Same-AZ NAT egress | RDS Multi-AZ failover

svg.text: Design note: Route 53 points the app hostname directly to the ALB; CloudFront serves static assets from the private S3 origin.
